title: Hearty Charred Portuguese Butternut Squash Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Portuguese dish featuring charred and juicy butternut squash, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. The addition of tempering chocolate adds a unique twist to this traditional dish.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed butternut squash to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated squash onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 20-25 minutes, turning occasionally, until the squash is charred and tender.
While the squash is grilling, melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Once the squash is done, brush with lemon juice and sprinkle with grated chocolate.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional paprika if desired.
